# CHARACTER scope. One minister holds at most one office, otherwise a single
# tier-3 star would occupy every slot in the household.
cc_office_holds_any = {
	OR = {
		has_variable = cc_office_held_seneschal
		has_variable = cc_office_held_master_of_coin
		has_variable = cc_office_held_herald_of_arms
		has_variable = cc_office_held_marshal_of_the_court
		has_variable = cc_office_held_clerk_of_the_signet
		has_variable = cc_office_held_keeper_of_the_wardrobe
		has_variable = cc_office_held_chancellor_of_the_rolls
		has_variable = cc_office_held_master_of_the_mint
		has_variable = cc_office_held_court_chamberlain
		has_variable = cc_office_held_master_of_protocol
		has_variable = cc_office_held_intendant
		has_variable = cc_office_held_permanent_secretary
		has_variable = cc_office_held_director_of_public_instruction
		has_variable = cc_office_held_court_chaplain
		has_variable = cc_office_held_court_astrologer
		has_variable = cc_office_held_grand_inquisitor
		has_variable = cc_office_held_ecclesiarch
		has_variable = cc_office_held_qadi_of_the_court

# CHARACTER scope. Deliberately coarse: seated, alive, not already posted, and
# trained in something. Whether a SPECIFIC office suits them is checked on that
# office's option in the picker, because the answer depends on the office. A
# minister who qualifies for nothing still opens the picker and is told so,
# which reads better than a dead button with no explanation.
cc_office_can_be_appointed = {
	in_cabinet = yes
	is_alive = yes
	NOT = { cc_office_holds_any = yes }
	OR = {
		cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = adm  TIER = 1 }
		cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = dip  TIER = 1 }
		cc_xp_tier_at_least = { TRACK = mil  TIER = 1 }
	}
}
